text:
Alyssa C: FYI, FinDocs just escalated — embeddings search + reranker returning irrelevant top results and latency spiking. They say this started after yesterday's ranker update. They attached examples (I'll paste minimal repro below).

Jamal R: Repro steps from support ticket: query 'how to file an LLC in CA' -> embeddings search returns docs about corporate tax, and reranker pushes a completely unrelated FAQ to top. Latency for rerank calls jumped ~2x.

Jamal R: Payload snippets:```
POST /v1/embeddings
{ "model": "text-embed-4-small", "input": "how to file an LLC in CA" }
```and reranker:```
POST /v1/rerank
{ "model": "redwood-ranker-v2", "query": "how to file an LLC in CA", "candidates": ["doc_17","doc_42","doc_8"] }
```

Alyssa C: Customer attached golden example where redwood-ranker-v1 returned doc_8 (state filing guide) at top, but v2 ranked it 7th. They say this broke a live workflow (billing tier impacted). Customer asked for rollback or hotfix.

Sophia P: Thanks — a few clarifying q's: 1) exact deploy time for redwood-ranker-v2? 2) is this specific to that customer or seeing other reports? 3) severity (SLA/monetary impact)?

Jamal R: Deploy was 2026-03-18 04:12 UTC (per deploy-bot). We've had one other report from a different customer in the last 12 hours, lower severity. FinDocs says they're losing conversions — asked for priority.

Mike L: @Sophia_P I can start a quick local rerank eval against the customer's sample set. Need the eval set + their candidate IDs. Also need the exact model commit/hash for v2. If we confirm regression, rollback to v1 is the safest short-term.

Alyssa C: Attached minimal eval: query list (5), candidate docs (per query), and expected top doc ids. Sending via secure drop.

Mike L: Running a dry-run now. If anyone can confirm the v2 commit: looks like `commit: 3a7f9d2` from the release notes.

Sophia P: TL;DR: escalate to product. Severity: customer class = enterprise, potential revenue at risk. Recommend P1 triage. Can we get an ETA for repro + PR for fix/rollback?

Mike L: ETA: repro + baseline diff by EOD (8 hours). If confirmed, rollback can be done within 30 minutes once we have approval and change freeze window.

triage-bot: Created ticket INF-874 in Product backlog and assigned to eng-ml. Priority: P1 (customer-impact). :white_check_mark:

Alyssa C: FinDocs requests temporary rollback while you investigate. They're OK with a short disruption if it fixes relevance.

Sophia P: Agreed — let's treat as P1. @Mike L please mark INF-874 with repro artefacts and add a short A/B test to compare v1 vs v2 signals (precision@1, nDCG). If rollback is needed we'll coordinate release.

Mike L: Will do. Also adding a small unit test to lock down reranker ranking for their golden queries so we don't regress in future.

prod-bot: Deploy freeze requested for ranker service pending INF-874 resolution.

Alyssa C: Thanks team. I'll keep FinDocs updated and request permission for rollback. :eyes:

Sophia P: Good. Please post the INF-874 link here when created and drop any short logs/metrics (precision@1 before/after).

Jamal R: Noted — looping in account exec to flag SLA exposure.

Mike L: Uploading initial diff now, will ping here when EOD results are in.

Alyssa C: :thumbsup:
